title: Weekend Load Shape Comparison
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dsmr:telegram
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H"), weekday=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval is_weekend=if(weekday>5,"weekend","weekday")
| stats avg(import_kw) as avg_kw by hour is_weekend
| sort hour is_weekend
description: Builds a simple weekend-versus-weekday load profile so you can see whether household patterns match the tariff assumptions and automations you built.
value: Different day types create different opportunities for cost control; comparing the shapes often reveals obvious timer changes you were not seeing.
implementation: Ingest import power continuously; review the hour-by-hour profile and adapt automations around the true weekend pattern.
visualization: Overlay chart of weekday and weekend average load by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how your home's electricity pattern changes on weekends compared with normal weekdays.
